name: currency-scraper
description: Currency exchange rate monitoring system for Georgian banks

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n BACKEND,FRONTEND,CRAWLER -c magenta,green,cyan "npm run backend:dev" "npm run frontend:dev" "npm run crawler:schedule"
scripts.dev:once: concurrently -k -n BACKEND,FRONTEND,CRAWLER -c magenta,green,cyan "npm run backend:dev" "npm run frontend:dev" "npm run crawler:start"
scripts.start:all: concurrently -k -n BACKEND,FRONTEND,CRAWLER -c magenta,green,cyan "npm run backend:start" "npm run frontend:start" "npm run crawler:schedule"
